statement.zh: Mughal 乔利斯坦调查（1982 专章；1997 专著）将甘韦里瓦拉记为哈克拉流域大型哈拉帕地表遗址；Kenoyer 引调查面积约 81.5 ha——属调查估计。
statement.en: Mughal’s Cholistan survey (1982 chapter; 1997 monograph) records Ganweriwala as a large Hakra-valley Harappan surface site; Kenoyer cites ~81.5 ha — a survey estimate.
